steps.content: You look down at the Legion soldier. His face is deformed, but you recognize it. It's not Earl's. It belongs to someone who didn't even tell you his name in your encounter with him earlier.

After the battle in the crypt, he accosted you. He draped his arm around your shoulders, making a move to be reconciled with you. He pressured you into emptying a big glass, as he babbled away about his dream of changing Syndicate with the Legion.

steps.speaker: Legion soldier
steps.content: Commander... Protect... Commander... Earl... Go... Quick...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Let's put him out of his misery. Hecate, you do it, you're quicker.
Nightmare ends his suffering. It has made quick work of it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Only the supporting machinery can be turned on. There is no response from the main machinery of the base stations.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: These are not enough to drive all the enemies away. And the commotion is going to draw more Corruptors to us.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...They are coming.
Under the purple light in the background, more deformed creatures are inching their way out of the curtain of dust not so far away.
Judging by what's left of the clothes worn by the Corruptors in the front, they were also once Legion members.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... It's the bro who helped me out once; I still owe him a couple bucks...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He's a Corruptor now, Hella. Don't back away. We have to fight.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know, but I... This is too much... This feeling... it's odd...
Ahhhhhhh!!
A mixture of anger and sadness is pouring out on the other end of the shackles. The lone fighter is howling and struggling, seemingly overcome by the tragic scene before your eyes.
Did Zoya see it through your eyes? Her pain is coming through to you from the other end of the shackles. This has never happened before. What happened in Keylan Square? What happened to Zoya?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, hang in there. We must fight... I can still fight.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I can't... let you...
Bang, bang—

The sound of gunshots... Bullets trailing pale-blue tails penetrate the torsos of a few Corruptors and cause real damage to them. They turn to their attackers, but are hurled into the air before they can mount a counterattack.

A white-armor man hacks his way with his ax to where you are. He is wearing a helmet with a visor that has a chip on the upper right corner that you recognize. He is the leader of the FAC team with which you had a fierce fight not so long ago.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings, captain of team N7, service number <color=#fb9259>036</color>, hereby report to you. We're not your enemy.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, our team will assist in protecting you.
He takes off his helmet. You recognize the face...

steps.speaker: Guard Captain
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale, take Chief away! You've got me here.
